text: Joji Joestar (城字・ジョースターJōji Jōsutā) mainly known as Jorge, is one of the main protagonists in JORGE JOESTAR, being the parallel version of George Joestar II. He is the temporary user of U-Boat after receiving it from Kars, and wields the omnipotent ability, Beyond. As a private detective, Joji sets out on a bizarre quest to solve a murder in Morioh. During the investigation, Joji suddenly reaches outer space, and meets 36 versions of Kars, each created after Made In Heaven reset the world thirty-six times.
Shilgengar is an extremely powerful demon lord who indirectly created the vampires of Innistrad, including the planeswalker Sorin Markov.

Marit Lage is a powerful avatar being comparable to a demi-god with a kraken-like figure who came to be imprisoned on Dominaria at some point before the Ice Age. In the BOOM! comics continuity, Marit Lage is at last freed from her icy prison on .
Time is the supposed (now reformed) main antagonist in the 2016 Disney film Alice Through the Looking Glass, the sequel to the 2010 film.
Unsealing a Rasengan from his Rinnegan, Momoshiki amplifies the chakra giving it a red colour and to increase its size to a giant scale, which rivals Boruto Uzumaki's own amplified Rasengan.
Bruce Banner, also known as the Hulk, was a scientist and vigilante who fought the s.

The Jade Emperor is a deity from the mythology of Chinese traditional religion (aka, Folk Religion) and is part of the Taoist cosmology. The entity was later incorporated into the Call of Cthulhu role-playing game by Chaosium, appearing as an Elder God in the Secrets of Japan supplement; however, it is stated that this classification should be taken loosely and used as a basis of comparison with Cthulhu Mythos creatures.

A Deathlord is one of thirteen mighty ghost-kings of the Underworld. Their power springs from their Neverborn masters and from their own great age and unmatched knowledge. The Deathlords are quite possibly the greatest threats to Creation in the Second Age.

A Scion is the main player character of the eponymous role-playing game. The children of ancient gods and goddesses of classic mythology, they serve as agents of their parents against the fierce Titans who threaten the very fabric of existence.

* A crazed cultist of the efreeti Memnon called Roshanak attempts to start a holy war against the Sword Coast. He assembles the beginning of a huge fleet in Calimport but has a vision so startling he abandons his effort and disappears. * Alazne Inthré is born to Laspeera in the middle of a meeting of Cormyr's Council of Mages * Winter: A very public scandal damages the reputation of the War Wizards when one of their own is caught conspiring with two courtiers in Suzail to defraud the Crown of Cormyr of money intended for road maintenance in order to set up palatial rental properties. Alusair Obarskyr reacts by increasing oversight (both overt and covert) of how tax money is spent. She also signs into law the practice of confiscating any properties acquired through misappropriated funds. * This year is known as the Year of Broken Hearts in the Black Chronology. ;Novels * Ascendancy of the Last begins.
Astral Dreadnoughts were gargantuan outsiders that roamed the Astral Plane.

* In battle with Sembian warships, Immurk the Invincible the pirate dies at the helm of his ship, Sea Scorpion. * An alliance of Thayan wizards launches an invasion of Aglarond, but are repelled after a close battle. * In the aftermath of the failed Thayan invasion, Szass Tam slays Nymor Thrul, the Zulkir of Illusion. * The pirates of the Sea of Fallen Stars cease their raids and begin warring amongst themselves as each of the 100 ships of the Dragonisle fleet declare allegiance to one of the six different captains claiming succession as leader. These are the Pirate Wars.

Astaroth was a mighty demon prince of the Infinite Layers of the Abyss, His title was Diabolus and he was concerned with matters of prophecy. After his death, "Astaroth" became an alias for the arch-devil turned god Gargauth, while the original Astaroth became a vestige.

Baba Yaga () was an extraordinarily powerful mage, archfey, and arch-hag. Some described her as the most powerful female mage ever known, a sorceress with a reputation for passing throughout the planes. In doing so, her magical hut also appeared elsewhere, and was reported to have arrived on Faerûn.

Ben-hadar, called the Prince of Good Water Creatures, the Squallbringer, and the Valorous Tempest, was the good archomental of the Elemental Plane of Water, and thus the counterpart and enemy of Olhydra. His symbol was a blue-green wave in a golden circle.

* The enchanted blade Albruin is stolen from Castle Obarskyr by the halfling thief Nypan, who manages to pass or sell it off before being captured and killed by Cormyrian soldiers in Wheloon. Rumors of the blade's whereabouts circle around a fence by the name of Blusken Shult, who may have transported it to a buyer located along some shore of the Wyvernwater, but this is never reliably confirmed. Albruin remains unaccounted for, for another 24 years.
Calim was the noble djinni lord who founded the Calim Empire in what is now Calimshan. For millennia his body and mind were split and imprisoned in the Calim Desert.

Demon lords, also known as Abyssal lords, were archfiends who gained great power and established a position of preeminence among demonkind. Over millennia, these demons had amassed tremendous power and authority over their domain.
Dheubpurcwenpyl was one of the most powerful deep dragons in the Underdark in the mid–14 century DR.

Dispater () was the Lord of Dis and an archdevil whose extreme vigilance almost personified caution. The urbane Iron Duke ruled the Iron City from within his Iron Tower, and was legendary for his impregnable layers of defense.
Bellekar, also known as Bellekar the Warlock, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard Zombies mode. She is a deity of the Dark Aether.

Arius is a supposed "God of Fire" and Volcano God who is worshiped by a primitive tribal people who lived on an unspecified island. In order to appease the god, the people would, once a year, sacrifice a child to the god. If the natives failed to fulfill this tribute, Arius was believed to erupt the island's volcano which would result in the death of hundreds of the villagers.
Garggeel is a Bone Colossus that appears in ; at Hightide Keep.

* King Bayle Carrathal of the Moonshaes attempts to annex Jannath's Tears into his kingdom. Baldur's Gate objects and sends a fleet that easily crushes King Carrathal's. * King Bayle is deposed and killed following his defeat at Jannath's Tears. * Yolanda Carrathal becomes Queen of Callidyrr after Bayle is deposed.

* Coram IV of House Tethyr is born. * Contemplating how to deal with ambitious family members, Emperor Wai Long Sun of T'u Lung eats rice from the enchanted bowls fashioned by potter Jo He Ting, which grant clear thought. However, they do not protect against poison, and he dies. His cousin, Wai Chu Doang becomes the fifth emperor. Exploiting the oath of loyalty, he raises large and strong armies as a defense against the baronial clans and against Shou Lung. His habit of using harsh, military solutions to resolve domestic issues leads to his reign being named "The Law of Fists".
Magnus, also known as the god of magic, is an et'Ada, one of the Original Spirits.

Magrus, commonly known as the Cat's Eye, or the Third Eye of Azurah, is the Khajiiti god of the sun and sorcery, especially venerated by magicians along with Azurah and associated with the multi-pantheon god of magic Magnus.
Mzeklok is a unique, gigantic Dwarven spider found in the ruins of Rkundzelft, Craglorn.

* Storms known as the "Teeth of Talos" lash the southern Sword Coast. A peninsula known as the Dragonstail sinks under the waves during the storms. Fishing fleets and the Ilmatari temple-town of Carathryn are destroyed. The sunken Dragonstail poses significant risk to all shipping near the Purple Hills.
Onkal the Harbinger is a powerful Bone Colossus found in the ruins of Rulanyil's Fall.

Tiber Septim, named using the regnal titles Septim I, Tiber I, and Tiber Septim I, and also called Hjalti Early-Beard, General Talos Stormcrown, the Red King, the Warrior-King, and Ysmir, was a Dragonborn, first Emperor of the Third Empire, and founder of the Septim Dynasty. Tiber is regarded as one of Tamriel's most famous figures, having been the only one in history to unite the continent. Starting with his service under the Cyrodilic Emperor Cuhlecain, Tiber Septim fought under the name "General Talos" to unify Cyrodiil, eventually succeeding or usurping Cuchlecain and becoming emperor. After his unification of Tamriel, an effort that culminated in the birth of the Third Empire, he ended the lengthy Interregnum and began the Third Era. Tiber Septim gave his name to the lineage of Cyrodiil Emperors, the Septims. Upon his death, Tiber Septim apotheosized into Talos and became a deity in the pantheon of the Nine Divines.

* Netheril attempts to establish diplomatic relations with High Imaskar. However, the effort falls apart when a ship given to the Imaskari by the Netherese is attacked by sea monsters and the Netherese abandon the Imaskari crew. * The Shadovar leader Herzgo Alegni applies pressure on Lord Hugo Babris of Neverwinter to have the Winged Wyvern Bridge renamed in his own honor. * A small adventuring party rediscovers the ancient dwarven city of Gauntlgrym. Consisting of Jarlaxle Baenre, Athrogate, and a trio of powerful Thayans, they awaken the ancient primordial Maegera when Korvin Dor'crae hypnotically forces Athrogate to activate the forges. * The Ruining: The city of Neverwinter is destroyed when Mount Hotenow erupts as a result of the awakening of Maegera, a primordial held in slumber through the craftsmanship of the dwarves of Delzoun and the elves of Iliyanbruen at the heart of Gauntlgrym. * All known heirs of the royal House Alagondar die in the eruption of Mount Hotenow. Their spirits haunt Castle Never. ;Novels * Gauntlgrym (chapters 1-9)

Vahlok (Dragon Language: Vahlok, "Guardian"), most known as Vahlok the Jailor, is a dragon priest. Along with Ahzidal, Dukaan, Miraak, and Zahkriisos, he is one of the five named dragon priests found on Solstheim in . Vahlok played a pivotal role in Solstheim's history, although the exact nature of which has partially been lost to time. Some legends suggest that Vahlok found out about Miraak's plot to overthrow the Dragons, resulting in a battle that caused Solstheim to break off from mainland Skyrim. Alternatively, Vahlok may have defeated Miraak elsewhere, then was dispatched as the guard of Miraak after the latter was exiled to Solstheim. Either way, Vahlok was revered on the island unlike any other dragon priest, being immortalized as "The Guardian."

Zandadunoz the Reborn, also known as Zanadunoz the Ravager, is a Daedric Titan that can be found at the Unfinished Dolmen, and is an extremely powerful enemy. He appears at the dolmen after several waves of Worm Cult and Daedra.

Almighty Shinra is a superboss in Final Fantasy X-2 International + Last Mission and HD Remaster versions. He is created as the result of Shinra absorbing the pyreflies of Omega Weapon. When defeated, he can be recruited into the party. The player must release him after completing his storyline to get the Last Resort Garment Grid.

* Hammer 10: The First Tymanther-Unther War ends with a decisive Tymantheran victory. * Marpenoth 9: The monks of Candlekeep are revealed to have several agents of other groups among their number, including Netherese, Red Wizards, and members of the Moonstars, including Laeral and Alustriel Silverhand. When the Netherese monks attack their fellows, the others reveal themselves and battle for control of the library. Elminster deceives the Netherese into believing that he is Telamont Tanthul and Larloch convinces him to use the wards of Candlekeep to bolster the new Weave but then betrays Elminster by stealing the power for himself. * Marpenoth 9 to Marpenoth 13: The flying city of Shade moves directly against Myth Drannor. Telamont Tanthul drains the energies of Myth Drannor's mythal in order to turn the new Weave into a Shadow Weave for his mistress. Larloch strikes against the elves in the confusion and the Srinshee appears to defend them. Shade eventually crashes into Myth Drannor but a hastily erected ward protects the Tree of Souls from the impact. * Hammer 10: The War Wizard Ilstan Nyaril sacrifices his life to allow the return of the god Azuth. * Marpenoth 9: Hadrhune is killed again. Telamont forbids his resurrection, owing to the potential interference of spirits trapped in the new Weave. * Marpenoth 13: Dove Falconhand succumbs to injuries sustained while rallying the baelnorn of Myth Drannor to come out of their tombs and defend their city. ** The Srinshee sacrifice
Jet Bahamut is the final boss of Final Fantasy XIII-2. It is the transformed state of Caius Ballad after his defeat on the beach in Valhalla. He is supported by Amber Bahamut and Garnet Bahamut.

Vayne Novus is the second form of Vayne in the final battle on board the Sky Fortress Bahamut in Final Fantasy XII. After being initially defeated, Vayne uses nethicite to transform into Vayne Novus and takes on the party again. Vayne Novus is fought alongside multiple Sephiras. Gabranth supports the party in battle. After Vayne Novus is defeated, he uses the absorbed energies of Venat to fuse pieces of the Bahamut unto his body, becoming The Undying.

Hecate was one of the Lords of Kobol and the goddess of the underworld. In the years preceding the Cylon War, Hecate became a representation of V-World's disturbing culture trends, with young women being forced to participate in their virtual human sacrifice to Hecate.

* A mysterious cabal known as The Six launches attacks against Acquisitions Incorporated in the Sword Coast North. * Ongoing conflicts escalate between the Xanathar's Thieves' Guild and the Zhentarim in Waterdeep amidst power grabs by groups like Acquisitions Incorporated. * Forces from the Far Realm attack the town of Red Larch. * The red dragon Balagos captures and maims the bronze dragon Ixolothingeir, and forces him to defend a secondary treasure hoard in the Starspire Mountains. * The splinter sect of the Zhentarim led by Manshoon seeks to solidify its power in the Sword Coast. The Zhent operative in Phandalin, Halia Thornton, is killed and replaced by a Manshoon loyalist named Sharna Quirstiron, who plots to subvert the town's leaders. * Waterdeep's Guild of Chandlers and Lamplighters goes on strike, leaving the city dark and dangerous at night. * The Blackstaff, Vajra Safahr, mobilizes the Gray Hands to determine the intentions of the green dragon Kofutacti, who was spotted above the Sea of Swords near Waterdhavian shipping lanes. * The town of Phandalin holds its first mayoral election. The candidates are Harbin Wester and Sildar Hallwinter. * Famous Waterdhavian actress Tystanya Creed disappears upon leaving the theater following a performance. * A member of the nobility of Waterdeep in the Southern Ward survives an assassination attempt when a bodyguard injures the assailant. A bounty is offered for the would-be assassin's capture, but the only description given is
Graz'zt the Seductive is the Demon Prince of Indulgence. One of the most powerful demons in the Abyss, Graz'zt rules over not one, but three layers, known as the domain of Azzatar.
the Weaver was the Shaper of the gnomes and a goddess of the moon and magic in Aramán.
The Molten Titan was an elemental titan composed of liquid metal who was felled by elves during the Founding and subsequently sealed beneath the earth, producing the Daggerbay Mountains.

* A Chancelgauntian ship-owner named Orlephar Flostren begins a large-scale development project in the trading camp at the mouth of the River Tesh on the Moonsea. It is renamed Flostren's Hold. It eventually grows into the city of Zhentil Keep. * The elves of Shilmista and King Strohm III of Tethyr forge an alliance against the Ring of Eyes in Cortryn.

The Shapers, sometimes called the Seven Lords of Creation, were the pantheon of gods worshiped on the world of Aramán. They received that name because, after they first manifested in this world, they changed the peoples they found on Aramán into new species such as orcs and elves, and set them apart on the continent of Pasitar. The term "Shapers" came into use only after the Shapers' War; prior to that they were universally referred to as "gods".
Sylandri the Green Mother was the goddess of life and the woodlands in Aramán, and the Shaper of elves.

Corellon, the Arch Heart is the deity of arcane magic and the fey. During the Founding, the Arch Heart wandered the lands, spreading magic and raising the forests. The Arch Heart created the first elves, and so they are considered the Mother and Father of all elves. Centaurs believe the Arch Heart to be their creator, as well. As both an NPC and a PC (in Downfall) the Arch Heart has been played by Abubakar Salim.

* King Beldred of Impiltur wielding the sword Dornavver, slays and drives the demons out of the Rawlinswood in a year-long campaign known as "the Scouring". * High King Kevan Cymrych of the Moonshae Isles dies of natural causes. * Dolan Cymrych becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles. * The Ilmatari priest Alledec creates Three White Doves, an exceptionally powerful magical mace.

Torog, the Crawling King is an evil god of torturers, slavers, and jailers. It is said that pathways under the world are the result of his tears of pain and anger, and his realm is a network of deadly caves and manacles. He was defeated during the Calamity by the Dawnfather and the Everlight.

* Sarshel Elethlim's paladin army defeats the demonic army of the balor Ndulu at the Citadel of Conjurers. Sarshel breaks the Crown of Narfell with the blade Dornavver. This ends the Fiend Wars and the Triad Crusade. * King Strohm II of Tethyr repels an invasion by Lower Tathtar. * Cortryn's ruling house is slain and its territories conquered by the Ring of Eyes, a cabal of beholders and beholder cultists originating from the Lake of Steam. The elves of Shilmista begin battling the Ring of Eyes without pause. * High King Ernest Cymrych of the Moonshae Isles dies of natural causes. * Carthus Cymrych becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles, but abdicates the same year. * Alec Cymrych II becomes High King of the Moonshae Isles. * The fallen duchy of Elestam officially becomes a part of Tethyr. * Unthalass in Unther is inundated by the Second Great Flood of the River Alamber. * Gilgeam, god-king of Unther, lays claim to the ancient mountain stronghold of the slain brown dragon Vulpomyscan and names it the Citadel of Black Ash. As historical documents and records in Unthalass have been destroyed by flood, Gilgeam tasks a group of scribes to take the ruined books and scrolls to the Citadel, restore them, and create an eternal archive of his achievements.

The Abbey of the Just Hammer was an abbey in Tasseldale, in the Dalelands, dedicated to Tyr. It was positioned close to the River Ashaba. The abbey's focus was upon the justice element of Tyr's portfolio and provided legal education for free. As of 1372 DR, the Abbey lacked numbers due to the drow threat in the north. On 22 Mirtul 1373 DR, the Abbey was attacked by the green dragon Sirvinhandra, who was defeated by Lord High Justiciar High Avenger Deren Eriach.

Oryx, the Taken King, born Aurash and formerly known as Auryx, was a Hive king that the Hive worshipped as a god. He is the main antagonist of The Taken King and the final boss of the story mission Regicide and the raid King's Fall. He was the father of Crota, and Nokris.

Panoptes, Infinite Mind was a massive Vex Axis Mind that oversaw the Infinite Forest on Mercury. It managed the simulations and was meant to reshape reality for the Vex. It was the final boss of the Destiny 2: Curse of Osiris campaign.
Atheon, Time's Conflux was a massive Vex Minotaur that oversaw the Vault of Glass on Venus.
The Academy of the Drawn Sword was a secret school dedicated to teaching warriors advanced sword fighting techniques.

Burg, the Stellar Jailer is a unique Ultra Colossus that replaces Bruiser Thurn in the Solstice of Heroes version of 1AU. Burg, along with Krusk, the Sol's Warden, attempt to stop The Guardian from reaching the Almighty's core.
Dûl Incaru, the Eternal Return is an Ascendant Hive Wizard and a daughter of Savathûn, the Witch Queen, serving as the final encounter of The Shattered Throne dungeon.
Saruut, Blood Infernal is an imprisoned Cabal Colossus seen battling Megor, Spawn of Xivu during the riot of the Prison of Elders.
The Absolute's warboard was a magical shield bearing the mark of the Absolute.

Savathûn's Worm is a Worm larva that once resided within the body of Savathûn, the Witch Queen and provided her with paracausal abilities, as is the case with all Hive. After being exorcised from the Witch Queen by Mara Sov and her Techeuns, the parasite was kept alive by the Awoken Queen, to whom it grudgingly assisted in return for its continued survival. It is currently being kept within the Exotic Grenade Launcher Parasite.

Tlaum, Sister of Vrag was a Cabal Colossus seen in the European Aerial Zone along with her sister Vrag, serving as a commander for the Red Legion. Assuming by her appearance with her sister, the two served as Bond Sisters of sorts, together obtaining control over a large Cabal battalion and attempting to seek control over the EAZ as a new base of operations.
Thesmotae, Subjugated Mind is a powerful Vex Hydra Vex Mind that serves as the final boss of Override: Tangled Shore and as the keeper of its own domain within the The Outer Nexus network.
Abdirak was a priest of Loviatar, the goddess of pain, in the Sword Coast region of the Western Heartlands in the late 15 century DR.

Xol, Will of the Thousands is one of the five Worm Gods, ancient paracausal creatures that mastered the Sword Logic and reputed as the creators of the Hive pantheon. He was worshipped by his High Priest Nokris, Herald of Xol and the Grasp of Nokris prior to his death and defection, and is the main antagonist of the Warmind expansion.
The Lady is the apparent leader of the Drowned. During the Great Enmity, she sent her minions to invade the shores of Sanctuary. The Drowned successfully conquered the entire coast of Scosglen.

DotMirageGaogamon is a Mega Digimon. It is a special MirageGaogamon that emerged from a keychain game. It is small but has power equal to other Mega Digimon. Its full potential is unknown. Attacks *Gale Claw: Slashes with quick claws. *Omega Rainbow Force:
Abela was a nymph that lived in the region of the Sword Coast in the mid–14 century DR.
The DigiDestined make a last stand to protect the Destiny Stone that is cut short by Azulongmon, a wise and powerful Digimon, who arrives to put an end to BlackWarGreymon's insane mission.

Lord Bagra is a Bagramon and the primary antagonist of Digimon Fusion. He serves as the supreme emperor of the evil Bagra Army, and is also the Digimon King. After his death at the hands of the Fusion Fighters, he is reborn as the Watchmaker.
The unnamed race of Jiren exists in Universe 11. Jiren is their most prominent member.
Acid arrows, also known as arrows of acid, were enchanted arrow projectile, commonly used throughout the Sword Coast and the Moonsea regions.

Polyphemus (Greek: Πολύφημος) was the original cyclops from the Odyssey of Homer. He appears in God of War: Ascension’s multiplayer mode as the boss of the desert map. He does not appear in the singleplayer campaign. Polyphemus is the gigantic one-eyed Titan son of Poseidon and Sea Nymph, Thoosa.
Triton (Greek: Τρίτων) is an Olympian God of the Sea, son of Poseidon and Amphitrite.
Unnr is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

A Fool's Errand is a companion adventure for the Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms that takes place in the Sword Coast region during the Festival of Fools celebration. The adventure is designed for a party of 8 to 10 levels.
Atemsis, All-Seeing is a legendary Sphinx from an unknown plane introduced in Core Set 2020.
Charix, the Raging Isle is a leviathan crab born from the ruins of the Tazeem Skyclave on Zendikar.
The Cinematic Phoenix is a legendary phoenix from an unknown plane.

The Abbey of Chauntea was an abbey dedicated to the Great Mother on the Sword Coast North, which stood from the 6 to the 10 century DR. It was part of the community of Bloodhand Hold, later Nimoar's Hold, and was one of its oldest buildings.
Cosima is the Skoti god of the sea from Kaldheim. She is curious, tempestuous, and can't stay in one place for long.
Eluge, the Shoreless Sea, also known as the Flood Gar, is one of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow.
The Ash Warlord Embereck was an Elemental planeswalker native to Dominaria. He was said to be one of that world's most powerful planeswalkers. He specialized in red mana.
The Abbey of Highsong, formerly Tharthyn Villa, was a temple to Milil located on the Sword Coast in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

The Entity of the Bog is a Worldsoul that had hidden itself in The Bog from the Approaches on Innistrad. It resided there for centuries, infusing everything in the area with its power. It seeped into the souls of the villagers and tied them to it.
Gherridarigaaz was a powerful Shivan dragon who allied herself with Urza on Dominaria.

Jodah is a powerful archmage from Dominaria, who was mostly present during the Dark Age and Ice Age for many of the important historical events on Terisiare during the period. He made a habit of gathering nicknames and epithets along his travels, most notably Jodah the Eternal.

The Absolute crisis was a series of events that transpired throughout the Western Heartlands and Sword Coast in the late 15 century DR, when the cult of the Absolute rose to power and caused great chaos across the region. It involved the Chosen of numerous gods, invading githyanki warriors, latent illithid corruption, and most notably, a returned alliance of the Dead Three gods.
Kraken are massive fiends from the deepest reaches of the ocean.

Kraynox, known as the Deep Thane, is an enormous, multi-limbed black-aligned New Phyrexian whose objectives were bound with the subterranean Mycosynth pillars between the completed Furnace Layer and Mirrodin's Core.
Lathliss, Dragon Queen, is a legendary dragon from an unknown plane.
A Feast for a Tenday was a dish made with pork, tomatos, and vegetables, and it took one's kitchen staff two days to complete.
Sedris, a.k.a. The Traitor King is the most powerful lich on the former Shard of Alara known as Grixis.
Teneb (TEHN-ehb), the Harvester, is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.
Toxrill is a slug horror worshiped as a deity in Nephalia, Innistrad.
Abdel's trusted shield was a unique enchanted shield that was once wielded by Abdel Adrian, the Bhaalspawn hero of Baldur's Gate.
Valthus was a Segovian Leviathan in the Golthonor Sea on Dominaria.
Ugin (/uːɡɪn/ OO-gin) is an elder dragon planeswalker from Dominaria.
Valgavoth, called the Devouring Father by his cult, is the extremely powerful elder moth demon who rules over Duskmourn.
A Modest Guide to Sword Coast Wine was a sommelier book with a self-explanatory title, published sometime in or before the late 15 century DR.
Wildsear, also known as the Wildfire Wolf, the Season of Flames, the Primordial Fire, and the Scouring Maw, is one of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow.
Vorosh (VOHR-ahsh)), the Hunter, is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

Naeori were an aquatic species native to Draco III, before Human colonisation of the planet. They were rare, and supposedly the size of a 'small island'. Along with other native species, Naeori survived the human terraforming of the planet by descending into the depths of the ocean, where they were safe from hunting. Naeori were often fed on by "bat-shaped" leeches. On the rare occasion when they surfaced, they would be hunted by humans such as Edward Buck's uncle, Lou. They had to be hunted with shocknets, as any other methods would drive them back into the ocean, and bombs would render the merchandise useless.
Acandar was an enchanted bastard sword of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.
Naliligaw is a Mgalekgolo who is in service to 031 Exuberant Witness as a guardian of Genesis.

The Primordial, also called the Captive or the Timeless One, and the Beast by the Tudejsa, was a mysterious being of great power once detained on Charum Hakkor, and supposedly the last surviving Precursor, its physical form altered to survive enormous stretches of time. While its body was ultimately destroyed, the Primordial would transfer its consciousness into the Gravemind, the Flood's compound intelligence, using the parasite as an instrument with which to exact its final vengeance on the Forerunners.

Darkdream was a forceful villain who once menaced Eternia until he was imprisoned by Man-At-Arms. Some time later, he got away and recruited Tavor and Evl-Lyn to blanket the planet in everlasting darkness so that he could thrive. In his eagerness for power, he pressured his minions to move one of Eternia's moons to create a solar eclipse, but the instability of this magic caused the moon to fall towards Eternia. When He-Man averted the collision, daylight returned to Eternia, and Darkdream was defeated one last time.
A Goblin Problem! is a children's book by Diane Walker. It is the first book in the second Dungeon Academy series.
Viltrumite Prisoners are some of the minor characters in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 to 3.
Immortals (仙 xian) are one of the Five Creatures in Journey to the West. They are also called 仙人 in Daoism. These refer to demi-god like beings.
A monkey is born from a stone nourished by the world's essence. He travels around the world to pursue the methods of becoming immortal.
Absorb weapon was an arcane spell that allowed an assassin to absorb a weapon they were holding into their skin for concealment.

is the son of the German hero, Brockenman. He starts in a antagonistic role, but then becomes an Idol Chojin thanks to Ramenman, his father's murderer. Years later, he becomes the trainer of Jade and raises him as his own son.

The All-Consuming Oni of Chaos was the mightiest of the oni on Kamigawa; a counterpart to O-Kagachi. Whereas O-Kagachi embodied the barrier between the mortal and spirit world, the order and the preservation, the All-Consuming embodied chaos, decay, hunger, and destruction.
Anzrag, "the Rampage Mole," is a Gruul Mole God from Ravnica.
Aegis-fang was the weapon of Wulfgar, son of Beornegar, of the Tribe of the Elk.
The Blood Avatar is a huge evil being on Arcavios, temporarily summoned by the Oriq Extus Narr.
Charix, the Raging Isle is a leviathan crab born from the ruins of the Tazeem Skyclave on Zendikar.
Eluge, the Shoreless Sea, also known as the Flood Gar, is one of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow.
Adamantine was the name of five jet-black alloys of adamant. Usually black in color, adamantine had a green sheen when viewed by candlelight or a purple-white sheen when viewed by magical light.
The Ash Warlord Embereck was an Elemental planeswalker native to Dominaria. He was said to be one of that world's most powerful planeswalkers. He specialized in red mana.

The Entity of the Bog is a Worldsoul that had hidden itself in The Bog from the Approaches on Innistrad. It resided there for centuries, infusing everything in the area with its power. It seeped into the souls of the villagers and tied them to it.
Esika is the green-aligned god of the World Tree from Kaldheim.
Aganazzar's scorcher, occasionally called simply scorch, was an arcane evocation spell that created a destructive jet of flame.
Grolnok is a massive frog worshiped as a deity in Nephalia, Innistrad.

Keruga is a legendary dinosaur hippo from the plane of Ikoria. Rielle considers Keruga a great sage like herself, and she took the planeswalker Vivien Reid to a meeting with the monster. While she stared into the beady eyes of the immense reptilian hippopotamus, Vivien understood she was in the presence of near-infinite knowledge. The wisdom Keruga gave to the planeswalker was a simple guttural sound, but according to Vivien that was everything she needed to hear. Keruga fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Kraken are massive fiends from the deepest reaches of the ocean.
Adamantite mace was an alteration spell that transformed a normal blunt weapon into a magical weapon of adamantium.
Kruphix is the God of horizons and time. He is associated with blue and green mana.
Kura is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. She is the reincarnation of Jugan.
Myojin (MYOH-jihn; ), are the greatest kami of all in the plane of Kamigawa.
Ahja the Azure was a male human magician of Luskan on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Ula is the Zendikar Merfolk god of the realms of water. He is known as Mangeni by the Kor and is their god of the sea, the blood of the world. Both deities are male and come from the same source: long-lost memories of the terrible Eldrazi Ulamog.
Wildsear, also known as the Wildfire Wolf, the Season of Flames, the Primordial Fire, and the Scouring Maw, is one of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow.
Vorosh (VOHR-ahsh)), the Hunter, is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.
Aec'Letec was a powerful nabassu from the Abyss that was worshiped by a group of cultists from the Sword Coast.
Xyris, the Writhing Storm is a legendary snake leviathan from the plane of Ikoria.
Silvar is a giant Cat Nightmare from Ikoria. Its bonder is Trynn.

Ureni is the Mythic Spirit Dragon associated with the Temur Frontier on the plane of Tarkir. This powerful entity was brought into existence following the completion of the Stormnexus Ritual by Narset, and was subsequently summoned by Eshki.

Adris Colebriar was a male human fighter and a merchant of the Six Coffers Trading Coster. He managed a branch office in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR. Adris was a shrewd trader, and through him the Six Coffers dominated trade in the town. The store sold all standard, non-magical weapons, armor, and equipment, typically at higher-than-normal prices.
Amphritrite is a recurring character in the Disney animated series Hercules. She is the Goddess of the Sea and the wife of the Sea God Poseidon.

Bill Cipher is the main antagonist of the Disney Channel/Disney XD animated series Gravity Falls. He is an extremely ancient and powerful Chaos God and Dream Demon with mysterious motives and seems to have a vendetta against the Pines family, especially his old rival, Stanford Pines.
Chaos is a god-like being from the Aladdin television series. He is a magical being that spreads (and may even be the embodiment of) chaos and mischief.
Aeger's Hide was an enchanted suit of armor that was crafted from the hide of the fabled bear known as the Aeger.

Clea is a Marvel Comics character who makes her Marvel Cinematic Universe debut in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, played by Charlize Theron. She is a sorceress with vast amount of magical power. Clea was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

Demeter is the Olympian Goddess of Nature, the Seasons, and the Harvest. She is very forgiving compared to the other Gods, even if someone hasn't made an offering to her all year she is still willing to forgive them, however, she detest those who pose as Gods and take credit for her fruitful bounties.
Granmamare is a character in the film Ponyo. She is the Goddess of Mercy and the queen of the Sea, the mother of Ponyo and her sisters and the wife of Fujimoto.
An adept was a divine spellcaster found in uncivilized or less sophisticated regions of Toril, where resources were not present to train either wizards or clerics.

Hela is a supervillain from Marvel Comics. Commonly an adversary of Thor, she is the Norse Goddess of Death, and ruler of the Norse underworld Hel. In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, she is Hela Odinsdottir, Odin's firstborn, the older sister of Thor, and the adoptive older sister of Loki. She appears as the main antagonist of the film Thor: Ragnarok. This version of the mythological Hela was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

Hermes is a supporting character in the Disney+ series Percy Jackson and the Olympians. He is the God of Travelers and the famous Messenger of the Gods who also doubles as a package delivery man. He is also the father of Luke Castellan.

Robert "Bob" Parr, also known as Mr. Incredible, is the protagonist of Disney•Pixar's 2004 animated film The Incredibles and the deuteragonist of its 2018 sequel. He is a superhero with the power of superhuman strength, being one of the most famous superheroes during the glory days of supers. Bob is married to Elastigirl (Helen Parr) and they have three children, consisting of Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack.
Agatha's spear of stirring was a large enchanted spear-like culinary utensil that belonged to a frost giant named Agatha the Cook in the 14 century DR.
Muckduck is a minor villain created for Joe Books' Darkwing Duck comics. He is a giant entity made entirely of garbage.

Thor Odinson (also known as Party Thor) is a character from the What If...? episode "What If... Thor Were an Only Child?" He is an alternate version of Thor Odinson, tangent from the prime Marvel Cinematic Universe, of Earth-616. In his universe, Thor grew up as an only child and to be a rambunctious adult who threw multiple parties throughout the galaxy. Thor is based on the thunder god of the same name from Norse mythology. This version of the character was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, Larry Lieber, Russ Heath, Werner Roth and Don Rico.

Proxima Midnight is a supervillain in the Marvel Comics, who debuted in the Marvel Cinematic Universe film Avengers: Infinity War and appeared in Avengers: Endgame as one of Thanos' adoptive children and ally to receive the six Infinity Stones. Proxima Midnight was created by Jonathan Hickman and Mike Deodato Jr.

The Aelusteen was a ship captained by Imbryn Ultal that plied the oceans of Toril around the 8 century DR. Imbryn Ultal sailed the Aelusteen between Sambar, the capital of Lantan, and the port city of Haunvaerune on the continent of Arandron, to trade in Lantanna inventions. On one such trip, Imbryn gave passage to the disguised steel dragon Velsaertirden from Haunvaerune to Sambar.

Quicksilver (real name Pietro Maximoff) is a character from Marvel Comics who is the twin brother of fellow Avenger, Wanda Maximoff, alias Scarlet Witch. He is a recurring character of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, debuting as a cameo in Captain America: The Winter Soldier. Quicksilver was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Slink's Mother is a minor character from Jake and the Never Land Pirates. She is a giant sea serpent who lives in the Cave of Neptune at the bottom of the Never Sea with her baby Slink.
Storkules is a character in the DuckTales reboot. He is the son of Zeus and an old friend/acquaintance of Donald Duck.
Adobe was a skill and craft used by the Azuposi people of the Pasocada Basin of Maztica.

T'Challa is a Marvel Comics character who is the king of Wakanda, a superhero, and a member of the Avengers. He dresses as the sacred spirit of the Black Panther to fight crime. In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, he first appeared in Captain America: Civil War, then returned as the titular protagonist of Black Panther. T'Challa later is a major ally of the Avengers in their fight against Thanos in 2018, only to be one of the victims of the snap, before being resurrected in 2023. Following Avengers: Endgame, T'Challa passed away from an unknown illness on May 3, 2024. He left behind a son named T'Challa II, whom he fathered with his girlfriend, Nakia. Black Panther was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. Chadwick Boseman portrayed the character in the Phase Three films of the MCU, with his role as the voice of T'Challa in the first season of What If...? being his last role before his death.

Super Super Big Doctor is the main antagonist of Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Candace Against the Universe. She took a planet by force and brainwashed the inhabitants into serving her. She wants to be seen as special and lives on the planet Feebla-Oot.
Tess is a minor character in Goldie & Bear. She is a giantess who lives in the clouds. She likes to play the harp.
Aegisheart was a magical short sword that was the favored weapon of Arvoreen, the halfling deity of guardians and defense. His avatar wielded it, alongside Hornet, another enchanted short sword.

José Tenoch Huerta Mejía is a Mexican actor and activist. Most of his roles have been from Spain and Latin American countries, but he has appeared in Just Walking, Spectre, Tigers Are Not Afraid, The Forever Purge, Caught Stealing, Mozart in the Jungle, Blue Demon, and Narcos: Mexico. For Disney, he played Namor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe starting with Black Panther: Wakanda Forever. He has also appeared in various internationally distributed 20th Century Studios productions. He played an extra in For Greater Glory, Carlos in Get the Gringo, and Carlos Mamani in The 33. For Fox, he played Adán Cruz in Here on Earth.

Violet Ventimillagia is a sports prodigy and a new A.N.T. She has a big crush on Fletcher Quimby. She is a recurring character and is known to have anger issues. She has unmatched strength, which gives her keen talent in sports, such as football, baseball, basketball, ice-hockey, lacrosse, and formerly ultimate fighting. Violet is mainly known for her quick-temper, dry-wit, and abrasive comments.

Xandra is a major character from Legend of the Three Caballeros. The Goddess of Adventure, she serves as a guide for Donald Duck, Panchito Pistoles, and José Carioca on their globetrotting adventures. She is voiced by Grey DeLisle.
An aegis blade was an enchanted sword meant to be wielded by a swordmage.

Xemnas is a major antagonist of the Kingdom Hearts series, serving as the main antagonist of Kingdom Hearts II and the first leader of the antagonistic Organization XIII. The Nobody of Terra-Xehanort, and by extension Terra and Xehanort, Xemnas is an extremely powerful Nobody holding dominion over all other Nobodies in a vein similar to his Heartless counterpart Ansem, Seeker of Darkness.

Zorlock is an evil wizard from Adventures of the Gummi Bears who wants to take over and/or destroy the world. A foe of the Ancient Gummies, Zorlock had attempted to kill Gummies and enslave humans, from which the ancient Gummies stopped him by casting the locking spell on him, trapping him in his underground cave, way below Gummi Glen, centuries ago. The cave was a subterranean island surrounded by magma, where the Great Gummies carved a giant statue of a Gummi soldier, along with a warning that the cave was forbidden to all Gummi Bears. In the episode "For Whom the Spell Holds", he turns a harmless rat into a monster named Grot, so that the creature is able to find the Great Book of Gummi and deliver it to him in his underground cave, so he could undo the spell which imprisoned him.

Madzilla is a one-time character in The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3, in the episode "Dadzilla." He is an in-universe fictional Hollywood character and the star of his own movie series parodying . When Kootie Pie and Big Mouth see Madzilla, they believe him to be their real father, so they use their Magic Wands to bring a mechanical version of Madzilla to life.
Adrian Freeman was a Netherese fighter and arcanist who led the Neth Underground for Freedom Fighters, and owned the Mythomian Warehouse in Eileanar in Netheril until its destruction in .

Violence Jack is a horror manga series by Go Nagai. It is known for having several serializations and one-shots that span twenty years (making it Nagai's longest running series) in addition to the intense violence and appearances from his other characters. The series is focused on Earth after going through a catastrophe that lead to Tokyo being disconnected from the rest of Japan and the land being torn apart in a survival of the fittest style. Within the chaos is a large amnesic man known only as Violence Jack. Jack gained his name for the violence that he gets himself and others into and the giant jackknife he wields. The original manga later reveals the world to be a remade version of Earth by God as punishment for Satan for his actions in Devilman. Jack and his extensions of power are later revealed to be the body and will of Devilman who manages to defeat Satan by regaining his original form. Subsequent manga tended to ignore this plot twist and have Jack as his own person. Despite fan opinions, Nagai considers this manga as being separate from other franchises; having the events take place in an alternate reality.
Bilibilero was the second generation on Waford. As one of the Colossi, it maintained the barrier around the Tower of Heaven. It is a secondary antagonist of One Piece Odyssey.
Aeriell was a human fighter and commander of her society's cavalry force, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Gomorrah is one of the two gigantic King Bulls owned by the Franky Family, the other being Sodom.

Jaguar D. Saul is a giant and former Vice Admiral who deserted the Marines and happened to wash ashore on Ohara. During the Buster Call that destroyed Ohara 22 years ago, he risked his life to protect a young Nico Robin and ended up frozen by fellow former Vice Admiral Kuzan. While Robin and the World Government presumed that he had died, he had actually survived. After collecting the books that Ohara's scholars sacrificed themselves to save, he brought them to Elbaph and went into hiding, after which he stayed and became a history teacher for the Walrus School, located on Elbaph's "Sun World" level. He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.
Primal Beast is a type of gargantuan which spawns in the Untainted Paradise unique mission.
Agannor Wildsilver was a human fighter and member of the Knights of Myth Drannor in the mid–14 century DR.

This Galarian Moltres is a /-type Legendary Pokémon formerly owned by Lucius. Currently, it is roaming the world after the Rising Volt Tacklers rescued it from Spinel and the Explorers. It can Terastallize into a -type Pokémon.
Kyle Rayner was the Green Lantern of Earth and a member of the Justice League.

Cosmic fury is an psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan after she ascended into a xel'naga. Kerrigan's powerful psionic presence causes her units to move and attack faster than they normally would.

Dungeon Craft The Dungeoncraft program is an official D&D Adventurers League initiative that lets community members write, publish, and run their own custom adventures. Published adventures can be sold on the DMsGuild provided creators follow specific design guides, campaign rules, and formatting standards Want to write your own adventure for Adventurers League play? Dungeoncraft (DC) adventures can be purchased from Dungeon Masters Guild - Currently supported DC settings: * Forgotten Realms (FR-DC) Spelljammer (SJ-DC) and Feywild (WBW) also are under the FR Campaign setting, along with Planescape has also been folded into FR, as areas of play for FR Characters as well. * Planescape (PS-DC) * Dragonlance (DL-DC) * Eberron (EB-DC) * Ravenloft (RV-DC) Program Details & Guidelines • Supported Settings: Creators can write adventures across multiple official settings, including Forgotten Realms (FR-DC), Dragonlance (DL-DC), Eberron (EB-DC), Ravenloft (RV-DC), Planescape (PS-DC), and Spelljammer. • Rules & Templates: Each campaign specifies allowed resource books, monsters, and magic item reward structures. Writers must use official Dungeoncraft style guides (such as Version 1.9c) and creator packs available through community hubs like Adventurers League Info. https://theadventurerleagues.com/vault/2024/07/Dungeoncraft__CCv1.9c.pdf • Publication Requirements: Content must be uploaded to the DMsGuild using the designated Dungeoncraft community filter to ensure proper classification

Sarah Louise Kerrigan was a psychic terran female. She began her career as a Confederate ghost and later became the second-in-command of the Sons of Korhal. Following Arcturus Mengsk's betrayal, she was captured and infested by the Zerg Swarm, becoming the self-proclaimed Queen of Blades (a.k.a. the Zerg Queen) and leader of the Swarm. At the close of the End War, she would ascend to become a xel'naga, a being of immense cosmic power. At the Dominion , ghosts in training are told the Confederacy allowed Kerrigan to "defect" to the zerg. Non-control zerg strains referred to her as "the Kerrigan."
Casse is a T-XA Terminator sent back chronologically by Skynet to ensure its own creation.

Tom Bombadil was a mysterious entity that lived for much of the world's history, known in the Third Age to dwell in a valley of the Withywindle in the depths of the Old Forest, east of Buckland, and close to the dangerous Barrow-downs. His domain was of modest size, but he seemed to possess an unequaled power over the land around his dwelling. He lived in a small house with his wife, Goldberry, between the Barrow-downs and the Dingle of the Old Forest, far from any other settlement. Although seemingly benevolent, he took no open stance against the Dark Lords.
Alascartha Vyperwood was a human woman and a fighter. She was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast.
Nira is an Elder God (probably goddess) and consort to Nodens. Nira and Nodens are in a constant war with Rokon and the serpent folk of Zandanua.

Rhogog was said to be created when Cthulhu and Hastur fought above the British Isles and Cthulhu shed blood, which several Star-Spawn put an 'entity' into for unknown purposes. This 'entity' lay dormant, growing in power until it became Rhogog. Rhogog is a great, black oak tree, hot to the touch, and a being of darkness, and unimaginable power.
Yikilth was a colossal iceberg-fortress created by Clark Ashton Smith for his short Cthulhu Mythos story "The Coming of the White Worm".
Alaine was a female human villager of Ember on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Abaddon, formerly known as the Grace of Wings, and later as the Lord of Filth and the Lord of Murder, is an Archduke of the fallen and the eternal commander of the Ebon Legion. One of Lucifer's five original lieutenants, he is a being of immense power, cold pragmatism, and a hatred so profound it has survived millennia of imprisonment. In the modern nights, he exists as one of the five most powerful Earthbound, a monstrous entity whose influence corrupts the very flesh of humanity.

Alaeros Margaster was a fighter, a member of the noble Waterdhavian Margaster family, and an agent of the Lords' Alliance. He played a critical role in stopping the Cult of the Dragon take control over the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.
Albav is a 6th generation Malkavian elder of unknown sire. Many Malkavians claim to have found her several times through history, as she seems to be always lurking in the Madness Network.

Ammut the Devourer is a primordial being of chaos who claims to predate even the Nameless Gods of Irem. The Shan'iatu sacrificed thousands of humans to her in order to fuel the Rite of Return, and she transformed these lost souls into the Shuankhsen.

An Antediluvian is a vampire of incalculable power, thirteen of whom survived the Biblical Deluge, and who are usually considered to be the founders of the thirteen clans. Technically, since "Antediluvian" literally means "before the flood", the term Antediluvian can be applied to any Cainite who predates the Great Flood, such as Caine or the Second Generation, but it is almost always used to specifically refer to the Third Generation, from whom the thirteen clans are descended.
Alaric Hembreon was a Tethyrian noble and member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR. He previously had served as the most powerful member of the City Council of the city of Zazesspur.

Archdemons are akathartoi whose powers are unquantifiably potent. Though the table in the sourcebook Inferno places this term as a rank just above the "Infernal Noble", the fact that it also notes Maeljin as archdemons seems to indicate that the term may be used for all demons above "Infernal Noble". Though it is unknown whether they are true lords of Hell or simply infernal beings that have come into great power, archdemons are inevitably famous, known by many names throughout many civilizations. Beings of such power are incredibly difficult to summon, requiring both an area of suitable desecration and a ritual of hideous atrocity.

glyph for Cahlash.]] Cahlash is the Bastet name for the Balance Wyrm, prior to its imprisonment and corruption. Shapeshifter theology includes a tale of the Purifier deity who, through torturous imprisonment by his malevolent sibling, fell from grace and became the Wyrm of Corruption. The Bastet say that Cahlash, the original balanced Purifier of the Triat, still exists, faithfully serving his original purpose and courting wild Nala. The whole mess with Banes and other vile things that plague Gaia comes from the Asura, the living incarnation of Cahlash's hate against his brother Rajah and his despair from his loneliness. When Cahlash ripped the Asura from himself, he hoped that the Asura would destroy only the corrupted things of Rajah, but the Asura turned into a multitude of serpents that infested the world, leading to the creation of Banes, fomori, vampires, and other rotten things. All these things may seem to be different, but they all are Asura in his many faces. Bastet can take Cahlash as their personal Jamak (Totem) without registering as Wyrm-tainted. Some of their Gifts draw upon Cahlash's power to destroy tainted and corrupted things or beings. Interestingly, both Cahlash and his brother Rahjah are known collectively as "The King of Cats."

Cytherea, the Divine Ignition is a Primordial who, along with Gaia, made Creation from the stuff of the Wyld; hence, "Mother of Creation" is one of her titles. In the time before Creation, when the Primordials slumbered and floated aimlessly in the Wyld, Cytherea was the second Primordial to ever awaken, and she was the one who awakened the others, including Mardukth and Theion. With the help of her brother Oramus, she created the Incarna Luna to convince their sister Gaia to stay in Creation, a plan that would eventually backfire when Luna fell in love with Gaia, convincing the latter to turn on the rest of the Primordials. She was abandoned by Gaia before the Primordial War and is now believed to be a Yozi. Aside from that, next to no records exist about her. One of her Third Circle Demons, Demirkol, the Wayward Child, rules his own region in Malfeas, known as the Domain of Seven Sorrows.
Akkabar's battleblade ring was the first of the Qysari Rings and could form a blade barrier when a command word was spoken.

In the cosmology of the World of Darkness (particularly Kindred of the East), the Ebon Dragon is the incarnation and embodiment of the concept of Yin. His mate is the Scarlet Queen and together, they created the Wan Xian. Dark and deathly places are where the Ebon Dragon holds sway, so this includes the Underworld of ghosts and the little places that are connected to the storms of that place. The Ebon Dragon allows the Gui Ren to transcend the veil of death, and by emulating his nature, they hope to understand and master their Dharmas. It has been speculated that the Ebon Dragon and Scarlet Phoenix are actually the Messengers, the last remaining Angels on Earth, who are responsible for creating the Imbued. Based on the lore of the Fallen, he might be Usiel of the Halaku, the Angel who, along with Lailah the Defender, remained faithful to God during the Great Debate.
Erzulie Danto, known simply as Erzulie, Mama Petro or just Petro, is the founder of the Petro faction of Les Invisibles and the singular most powerful Loa in the Mirrorlands.
Ezuli is a Follower of Set with a potent power base on Haiti. She is revered by local voodoo cults as a goddess of the moon.
Akbet-Khrul was a pirate lord of the Pirate Isles of the Sword Coast.

The rarest of the Forsaken's enemies, these chthonic entities are the spirits that represent concepts that existed before the world was fully formed. As such, they have no place in reality and exhibit powers and motives beyond comprehension. Originally imprisoned on the moon, some of them were able to escape during the first manned moon landing and now roam the earth.
Lady Yul, the Mistress of Toxins, is the Maeljin of Wakshaa, the Elemental Wyrm of tainted Water, and controls the Duchy of Toxins in Malfeas.
Laurel is a Seelie Sidhe of House Fiona, presumably a Wilder, and Queen of the Kingdom of Northern Ice.
Stablemaster Alark Phlamtryn was the head of the staff of The Redmark inn in the town of Harrowdale in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Mask of Winters is one of the Deathlords, dead Solar Exalted who made a pact with the Neverborn to destroy all Creation. His conquest of Thorns shocked the living and upset the balance of power among the dead.

Mnemon is the Earth Aspected founder of House Mnemon and one of the oldest surviving founders of the Scarlet Dynasty. She is approximately 400 years old in the present of Exalted, and is the most powerful living Sorceror in the Realm. She is considered the foremost contender for the Scarlet Throne, and is a strong patron of the Immaculate Order. Mnemon is the youngest child of the Scarlet Empress by her first consort and probably the third of her children to reach adulthood. She's the full sibling of Ragara and probably Cynis, making her the oldest of the Empress' children still to be active in Realm politics (Cynis is dead and Ragara retired). She is the signature Earth Aspect character.
Nazriel, today known as Nazathor, Princess of Majestic Liberation, is the leader of the Second House of the Fallen and one of the most powerful demons that managed to escape the Abyss.
The Akanapeaks were a mountain range in Chessenta, forming its historical western border. The south-western part of the Akanapeaks was claimed by the Blade Kingdoms.
Number Two was once a Black Spiral Dancer who served the Wyrm so well that all of the Triatic Wyrms combined their power to transform him into an Incarna.

Olokun (pronounced O-LO-koon) is an androgynous Orisha of all bodies of water and of wealth and can appear as male, female, or as neither. The Eshu use the name to signify Selkies and, to a lesser extent, other aquatic kith.

In Trinity Universe terms, a paramorph is one of three types of supernormal entities (the others are eximorphs and psychomorphs). Known to the denizens of the Adventure! Era as daredevils, they are typified by having extreme luck and/or skill. In general, paramorphs can be said to exhibit subconscious control over perpendicular time: probability. Theoretically, with a sufficient influx of power (such as that experienced by Maxwell Anderson Mercer caught at the centre of the Hammersmith Incident) a paramorph could be "bumped" past the normal limitations of their abilities to a new plateau of power: conscious control of linear time. Hence Mercer's ability to manipulate time and to travel through it.
Alagh's Pass was a naturally-occurring mountain pass that wound its way through an area of the Sword in the Anauroch desert.

The Prince of 100,000 Leaves is an Abyssal entity known under many titles in his existence: He Who Reveals Wisdom in the Fading Moonlight, Khonsu-Tohut, the Drama of the Outcast Erinye, the Secret Branch of the Tree of Possibility and the Blasphemous Scribe. He is one of the most powerful abyssal entities with an active foothold in the Fallen World.

The Shan'iatu were powerful beings able to utilize strange forms of magic. They were once the de facto rulers of the Nameless Empire, and were instrumental for the creation of the Rite of Return. They led the six ancient guilds with seven guildmasters at the head of each one, occupying a space between gods and mortals in the eyes of their servants. Though they were not gods themselves, their unbelievable power still captures the devotion of mummies in the modern day.
Thoth (original form Djehuti) is the Egyptian god of magic, usually depicted as a man with the head of an ibis or a baboon. Among the Greeks and Romans, Thoth was often equated to Mercury or Hermes.
Akkarrak was a deinonychus animal companion of Clawkeeper Kzheemoc, a beastmaster of the Batiri Shattered Spear tribe in Chult circa 1374 DR.

The Unity - also revered as the All-Encompassing or the King of Obedience - is the Exarch of Mind and one of the four Archigenitors. She grants the Prelacy of Obligation and his Ministry is the Hegemonic Ministry. Her number is one. According to the Seers, he is responsible for cleansing people of their individuality. People are weak alone, but together, acting under one will, they might taste the divinity they lost when they Fell. They need only sacrifice freedom. She whispers of the joys of conformity and manifests through impersonal institutions such as banks and governments.
Versak, was a former god of Law and Death, in the Long-lost Atlantean Pantheon .

__NOTOC__ An'dure the Awakened is a colossus located in the Jorune Mine in Talador. He was given his name by the draenei and slept beneath the earth for ages, until he was awakened by the actions of Kaelynara Sunchaser. Archmage Elandra and Manduil Skycaller ask adventurers to retrieve An'dure's heart so it can be used to break through Kaelynara's magic shield.
Air genesi armor was a type of intricate enchanted plate mail created by, and for, air genasi.

Ancient Guardians (also known as ancient protectors, Ancients, or ancients) are Wild Gods. From the dawn of its reshaping by the mysterious titans, Azeroth had been guarded by demigod beings who were tied to the world as no other creatures could be. The dragons had been empowered by the titans, but Azeroth itself gave rise to the spirits and demigods, creatures eternal in nature yet capable of ultimate sacrifice. Loa is the word that trolls use to refer to powerful spirits they revere, this includes the Wild Gods. Troll druids visiting Moonglade have been overheard calling the wisps who reside there loa, just as they refer to Goldrinn, Aviana, and the other returned Ancients as loa. Night elves and tauren have tried to counsel these trolls on "correct" druidic nomenclature, but the trolls thus far have been stuck in their ways. As they were a fierce opponent for the Burning Legion in the War of the Ancients, the demons had Cenarius killed in the Third War. This resulted in the seclusion of the Wild Gods. Malfurion Stormrage sent his druids to rally them and bring them into the field. The death of Cenarius, however, made them almost impossible to find. Ultimately, the druids were unsuccessful.

Azuregos was a world boss found in southeastern Azshara. The blue dragon Azuregos is a trusted servant of the aspect Malygos. As a blue dragon he is incredibly interested in magical artifacts and their protection. For this reason he guarded the ancient night elf Ruins of Eldarath, in modern day Azshara. Since WoW's 13th Anniversary, Azuregos is available during the anniversary event.

The black dragon Nalice hid with her Blackwyrm Cult in the Master's Cellar beneath Karazhan, Medivh's former home and one of the most powerful magical locations on Azeroth, researching arcane secrets buried beneath the foundation to perform some sort of arcane experiments. Rogues seeking to gain the were tasked with going to Karazhan, linking up with Wrathion's agent, then killing Nalice and obtaining a vial of her blood.
Ammon was a scholar who was active on the Sword Coast during the mid–14 century DR.
Bodash the Hoarder is a sea giant located at the Rockaway Coast in Highmountain.

C'Thun (sometimes spelled C'thun and pronounced "Kuh-THOON") is the Old God of madness and chaos, one of the four ancient and powerful creatures who ruled the world of Azeroth long ago before being defeated and imprisoned by servants of the titans. C'Thun created the qiraji and resides within the city of Ahn'Qiraj in Silithus. It is an unfathomably evil entity whose pervasive power has suffused Azeroth since time immemorial. In recent years, C'Thun freed itself. Champions of the Alliance and Horde chose not to wait for the Old God to build up its strength. They invaded the city-kingdom of Ahn'Qiraj, fighting countless qiraji and silithid before finally confronting and defeating the malevolent god. Even so, it is unknown whether Azeroth has truly seen the last of C'Thun. It appears in World of Warcraft as the final encounter in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, implemented in patch 1.9. C'Thun served as one of the main antagonists of classic World of Warcraft.

Cyrukh the Firelord is an elemental fury found in the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley. He is referred to as an elemental lord, which could make him near Ragnaros in power, as well as sharing a title ("Firelord") with him. He is also called "The Dirge of Karabor".
Amasal was an enchanted sword that was once carried by the elf hero Gaeleath.

Dargrul the Underking is leader of the drogbar and the most powerful Underking since the age of Neltharion. Soon after the Burning Legion's arrival, Dargrul destroyed the peace between the tauren and the drogbar tribes of Highmountain by murdering High Chieftain Ulan and stealing the Hammer of Khaz'goroth, a powerful artifact protected by the tauren. Using the terrible power of the Hammer, the Underking intends to take control of Highmountain. He serves as the main antagonist of the Highmountain storyline.

Sire Denathrius, the Master, is the creator and the former leader of the realm of Revendreth and its inhabitants, the venthyr people, which he ruled from Castle Nathria. Calculating and methodical, Denathrius is ancient beyond measure and one of the most powerful beings in all the Shadowlands. He created the venthyr in his likeness, forging them from the souls of the redeemed. The first venthyr were born directly from Denathrius' will, such as Prince Renathal who considers him his father. He is also the creator of the Nathrezim, cruel and cunning beings with the purpose to be the greatest spies and infiltrators in all of reality, in order to spread the influence of Death throughout the cosmos. In a midst of a rebellion caused by the anima drought that’s swept over the Shadowlands, rumors suggested that Denathrius may no longer be fit for the role of Master of Revendreth. Crowning a new Sire could return the plane to its former glory, or leave it mired in the same decadence and sin it is charged with cleansing. Consequently, Denathrius beseeched Azeroth's champions to help him quell the rebellion led by Prince Renathal, which threatened to destroy the venthyr way of life, but not all was as Denathrius claimed. In truth, Denathrius has been corrupted by the very sins Revendreth swore to punish.
